name: Sonnet deep value
strategy: Round 2: rotate into unloved cyclical/value large-caps (energy, financials, autos, healthcare) that missed the AI-led melt-up, add small-cap value beta via IWM, and run a small levered short-BTC hedge against a continuing crypto bear, holding sizable cash for drawdown buys.

positions.thesis: Integrated energy major, FCF yield still attractive; steady ~+2% drift to $156.71 with no new catalyst -- held unchanged.
Cheap at ~15x P/E with a 10% dividend hike; stock near highs (~$357) on strong newsflow (enterprise AI rollout, $750B housing initiative, lead role in the Anthropic IPO) -- held unchanged.

Q2 beat/raised guidance thesis intact and stock trades near record territory, but Trump's threatened 50% tariff on Canada-built vehicles is a live overhang (stock -2% this week to $86.27) -- trimmed modestly to de-risk the trade-policy tail.
Mean-reversion off medical-cost-fear lows continuing (~$401, back up from a governance-lawsuit-driven dip to ~$391); Buy-rated with a $475 average target vs current price -- held unchanged.

Deep-value re-rate keeps confirming -- fresh 52-week-high territory (~$28.30, up from $26.76 two weeks ago) on new FDA COVID-variant vaccine approval and an active obesity/oncology/immunology pipeline (19 pivotal starts guided over 12 months) while still yielding ~6%; sized up to press the winner.
Small-cap catch-up trade continues to run -- Russell 2000 at record highs, now beating the Nasdaq 100 YTD, with a cited ~34% valuation discount still unclosed; held unchanged.

Q2 beat and raised FY guidance (EBIT to $10-11B) plus fresh analyst upgrades (Jefferies to Buy, $17.50 PT) have not moved the stock, which is flat-to-down at $13.88 (vs $13.98 two weeks ago) because Canada-tariff threats and a weak July US sales print (-10.2% YoY) are capping it -- trimmed further to shrink exposure to a name where policy headline risk is overriding fundamentals.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-29: Both BTC-USD short legs in this book have effectively been killed by price action: the current 6%/2x short (entered ~$64.9k, stop -15%) already triggered on 2026-08-18 at $69,266 per the standing-order log, and BTC has since continued to melt up to ~$79,700 (+23% from the ~$64.9k reference), decisively breaking the 'multi-quarter downtrend' thesis this hedge was built on -- re-shorting into a rally that just stopped out the same trade once already is not a good risk. Dropping the crypto hedge entirely and redeploying to cash.
